GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 5l off 3 Wide No Cover , ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide without cover from the 100m. Passing the 500m was bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Debut for stable. Slow away. Pushed to recover & raced keenly behind leader on inside (2L from lead). Tracked leader on inside midrace & back 1 length @ 700m. Pushed to quicken @ 600m & chasing on rail (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 400m & held ground in last 200m. # Every Chance

Began well. Worked fwd & shared lead on rail until s/d in lead on rail (1L clear). Over-raced & held lead on inside midrace & pushed to quicken @ 500m. Pushed along Two Wide (1L clear) on home turn. Pressured & challenged @ 300m & headed @ 200m. Outgunned in last 150m. # Led - no match

Away fairly. Raced keenly 6th 3 Wide With Cover (4L from lead) early . In Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 600m. Pushed along Five Wide @ 500m & out Seven Wide (2L from lead) on ome turn. Prressured & laid in @ 250m. Worked home steadily without threatening in last 150m. # Steady effort.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 6 lengths. hard ridden turn 5 lengths. kept coming in Straight # Even Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced in the middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 7th 3 Wide 7 Lengths 800m 7th Under Pressure 8 Lengths home turn 6th Hard Ridden Kept Going Ok Straight # honest effort
Slow Out 3l Settled Down 2nd last 8 Lengths 1000m 8th fence 7 Lengths home turn 9th rails Straight no run final100m # slow out/chk late
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 5 lengths. moved up 3 Wide turn 2 lengths. weakened # Every Chance
Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 3 Wide 4 lengths. moved up 3 Wide turn 1 length. battled on very well # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: At the start was hampered. Raced wide and without cover throughout the event. Rider was reminded of her responsibility to ride her mount out fully to the end of the race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length worked around to settle Mid Field 3 Wide 3 lengths. very Wide turn 3 lengths. weakened # not much luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin and, soon after, was bumped and as a consequence became awkward on heels. Raced three-wide throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down Mid Field 5 lengths. looking for run turn 3 lengths. held up early in Straight . ran on well when clear # not best luck
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Passing the 700m was steadied from the heels of rnr after improving to be awkward on the heels of that runner and got its head up. Was held up for clear running in the straight until near the 200m .

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield 3 Wide No Cover (6L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 550m & improving 3 Wide @ 450m. Chasing Five Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & worked home soundly in last 200m. # Wide/ran on.
